title: feat: add Ling 3.1 Flash with Vercel fallback
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash`: no aliases, 262144 context, text input/output, tools and reasoning; primary pinned to OpenRouter Novita.
- Launch pricing: zero cost, `priceMultiplier: 1`, `paidOnly: false`; available with Quest Pollen.
- Adds hidden fallback `inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash:vercel:novita`, pinned to the same checkpoint through Vercel. Uses the existing fallback mechanism and credentials; both gateways depend on Novita.
- Excludes unsupported structured outputs, `response_format`, `logprobs` and `top_logprobs`.
- Pricing follow-up #16256 must activate on October 13, 2026 at 16:00 UTC (18:00 Berlin), per [Novita's promotion notice](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/novita-ai-labs_ling-31-flash-api-playground-novita-activity-7510737414517248000-M4mT).

## Verification

- 161 Gen and 63 Enter focused tests pass; Gen typecheck and formatting pass.
- Forced real primary failure: Vercel passes Chat and Responses (streaming/non-streaming), native text, tools, reasoning, token limits, long-prefix caching, identical-response cache HIT, permissions and a three-request burst.
- Staging final billing events match response usage, attribute the hidden Vercel route, and record zero cost/price; the local wallet is unchanged. No missing-rate warnings.
- #16256 remains blocked until Vercel's post-promotion rates are verified; its fallback cost currently reflects the free promotion.

gist.headline: Ling takes the scenic route
gist.blurb: Ling 3.1 Flash joins the model garden with room for long conversations, tools, and reasoning. If its OpenRouter route stalls, a hidden Vercel route leads to the same Novita checkpoint.
gist.summary: Adds inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash with a 262,144-token context, text, tools, and reasoning, routed primarily through OpenRouter Novita with a hidden Vercel fallback to the same checkpoint.
gist.impact: Developers get Ling 3.1 Flash at zero launch pricing, including with Quest Pollen, while the fallback keeps requests on the same checkpoint; structured outputs and logprobs are not supported.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Ling 3.1 Flash as a glowing text-model terminal with two garden paths labeled OpenRouter and Vercel converging on one Novita flower pot, making the shared checkpoint and fallback clear. Polli, wearing a tiny navigator scarf, points the friendly CRT monitor robot toward the alternate path.
